dedupe_keys.name: south bend public transportation corporation gtfs schedule and real time transit data

description: South Bend Public Transportation Corporation: GTFS schedule and real-time transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by South Bend Public Transportation Corporation. Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Saint Joseph County, Indiana, United States, with real-time vehicle, trip or alert feeds. Coverage: Saint Joseph County, Indiana, United States. The Mobility Database lists 1 GTFS schedule feed and 3 GTFS Realtime feeds for this provider (Saint Joseph County, Indiana, United States). At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the Mobility Database listing (licence field empty). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
